notes: «وقال بكر بن مضر» starts a second isnad for the same saying (not a variant); both routes meet at Amr and share «بكير» onward, written once.
Ibn Abbas, Ibn Azhar, al-Miswar and Aisha send and answer inside the story; they are scene, not links. «قال ابن عباس وكنت أضرب» is Ibn Abbas's remark inside Kurayb's account, not the saying.
